title: Don't Read Everything: A Curvature-Conditioned Query for Linear Attention
abstract: arXiv:2606.01294v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Linear attention reduces the quadratic cost of softmax attention by maintaining a recurrent fast-weight state, but it consistently lags on in-context retrieval and long-context tasks. Existing remedies act on the write side of memory through gating, delta updates, or kernel feature maps, but the read step is left unchanged: every past key contributes additively to the output, so useful targets are diluted by the bulk of stored vectors. We borrow one specific piece of softmax's geometry to construct a cheap read-time contraction of the query. A second-order Taylor expansion of the softmax log-partition at the isotropic-attention point gives a local quadratic model whose curvature coincides with the running key covariance, a quantity that can be maintained with the same recurrent/chunkwise mechanism as the linear-attention state. translated_title: 不要读取所有内容：面向线性注意力的曲率条件化查询
translated_abstract: 线性注意力通过维护一个循环的快速权重状态来降低softmax注意力的二次方计算成本，但在上下文内检索和长上下文任务上始终表现不佳。现有的补救措施都作用于记忆的写入端，例如门控、delta更新或核特征映射，而读取步骤却保持不变：每个过去的键都以加性方式贡献到输出中，导致有用的目标被大量存储的向量所稀释。我们借用softmax几何结构中的一个特定要素，构建了一种低成本的读取时查询收缩方法。在各向同性注意力点处对softmax对数配分函数进行二阶泰勒展开，可以得到一个局部二次模型，其曲率恰好与运行中的键协方差重合——这一量可以采用与线性注意力状态相同的循环/分块机制来维护。相关的线性算子在查询被读取之前沿记忆的高方差方向对其进行收缩……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在读取端（而非写入端）改进线性注意力，通过对softmax对数配分函数做二阶泰勒展开，构造出一个曲率等于键协方差的查询收缩算子，在读取时沿记忆的高方差方向收缩查询，从而提升上下文内检索和长上下文任务的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper improves linear attention on the read side rather than the write side by deriving, from a second-order Taylor expansion of softmax's log-partition, a curvature-conditioned query contraction operator whose curvature equals the recurrently maintainable key covariance, shrinking the query along high-variance memory directions to enhance in-context retrieval and long-context performance.
